scenario: Component installed in two machines simultaneously
acceptance_contract: Allow one active installation interval per serial; closing old custody and opening new custody are atomic

scenario: Asset moved while an old repair is reported
acceptance_contract: Preserve installation/location at the incident; record new current location separately

scenario: Parent and component form a cycle
acceptance_contract: Reject direct and transitive cycles before moving a subtree

scenario: Parallel pump fails but standby keeps line running
acceptance_contract: Separate component condition from confirmed line impact; do not propagate failure blindly

scenario: Asset retired with open repairs and plans
acceptance_contract: Preview and explicitly resolve references; retirement is a dated business event, not silent deletion

scenario: Old physical QR scanned after asset replacement
acceptance_contract: Show retired/replaced identity and require confirmation before routing to replacement

scenario: Critical asset has a cosmetic defect
acceptance_contract: Retain asset criticality and job urgency as distinct fields with reasons

scenario: Criticality changed after past work completed
acceptance_contract: Keep the prioritization basis at execution time; do not rewrite historical risk context

scenario: Warranty differs for two units of the same SKU
acceptance_contract: Bind coverage to serial/lot/receipt; SKU-level coverage must not certify every unit

scenario: Book value is zero while replacement lead time is long
acceptance_contract: Treat book value, operational value, quote and lead time separately; retain decision owner

scenario: Repaired motor returns from vendor
acceptance_contract: Retain its physical serial and old service history; do not create a fresh identity

scenario: Five physical spares include one quarantined unit
acceptance_contract: Readiness uses serviceable balance; quarantine requires recorded release evidence

scenario: Issue spans two lots
acceptance_contract: Store both lot quantities; line totals reconcile to issue quantity

scenario: Defective lot discovered after several repairs
acceptance_contract: Find exact linked issue/install records and affected jobs; do not report every same-SKU job as affected

scenario: High-temperature substitute approved in one direction
acceptance_contract: Do not infer reverse equivalence; record requested and actual parts and approval context

scenario: Recipe is added while components remain on shelves
acceptance_contract: Expand component requirements without increasing physical kit stock

scenario: Stocked kit assembled then components issued again
acceptance_contract: Consume component balances on assembly and prevent double-counting stock

scenario: Ten ordered; four received; six canceled
acceptance_contract: Retain ordered10, received4, canceled6 and outstanding0 with distinct events

scenario: Eight delivered; two fail receipt inspection
acceptance_contract: Keep arrived, accepted and rejected quantities distinct; unusable stock is not installable

scenario: Invoice quantity/price differs from accepted delivery
acceptance_contract: Flag quantity and price discrepancies separately; record freight/tax/currency context without sending payment

scenario: One child job is unfinished when parent package closes
acceptance_contract: Refuse completion until required children are verified or explicitly waived by authorized owner

scenario: Parent spending includes child rollup
acceptance_contract: Aggregate child costs once; avoid adding a parent rollup as another expense

scenario: One required predecessor is skipped
acceptance_contract: Require a reasoned eligibility decision for downstream work; skip is not verified completion

scenario: Dependency A waits on B and B waits on A
acceptance_contract: Reject cyclic dependency graph before scheduling

scenario: Verified predecessor is reworked after dependent work begins
acceptance_contract: Flag downstream work for review; do not silently retain green readiness

scenario: Electrician available three hours; machine window only one hour
acceptance_contract: Check intersection with duration; staff availability and machine access are separate

scenario: Production withdraws a maintenance access window
acceptance_contract: Preserve job and planned window history; return scheduling to review

scenario: Shutdown includes multiple machines with different owners
acceptance_contract: Each child retains its exact asset, responsible person, evidence and verification

scenario: One child delay shifts package dates
acceptance_contract: Show derived schedule change separately from approved contractual due dates

scenario: Line handback is mistaken for individual repair completion
acceptance_contract: Record named handback decision with required checks; individual Done is not a blanket authorization

scenario: Three four-hour repairs assigned to an eight-hour worker
acceptance_contract: Show overload based on estimated effort and availability; never imply all deadlines are feasible

scenario: Sick leave starts during an active repair
acceptance_contract: Escalate ownership review and preserve prior assignment/shift history

scenario: Worker role exists but required specialist skill is missing
acceptance_contract: Require manager-confirmed capability; access role alone is not qualification

scenario: One worker booked at two locations
acceptance_contract: Share one capacity budget; do not spend the same shift twice

scenario: Vendor name attached to job
acceptance_contract: Treat as business reference; keep an internal sponsor responsible for review

scenario: Provider link received by another person
acceptance_contract: Future portal requires scoped identity authorization; possession of a link alone is not factory authority

scenario: Contractor reports complete
acceptance_contract: Keep performedBy distinct from recordedBy and wait for internal verification

scenario: One of several technicians goes off shift
acceptance_contract: Preserve remaining owners and exact contribution; handover acknowledges only stated responsibility

scenario: Worker becomes manager while assigned repair is open
acceptance_contract: Expose stranded assignment and require a reviewed ownership transfer; do not silently change repair authority

scenario: Original signup name differs from chosen display name
acceptance_contract: Assignment uses consistent current display identity while historical events retain their snapshot

scenario: Gauge fails as-found but passes after adjustment
acceptance_contract: Keep both readings; a final Pass cannot erase the initial failure

scenario: Tolerance is percent of scale versus percent of reading
acceptance_contract: Store the tolerance basis, unit and reference; do not interchange formulas

scenario: Calibration reference later found inaccurate
acceptance_contract: Reverse-link exact standard serial and use period to potentially affected calibration jobs

scenario: Same seal fails after three separate verified repairs
acceptance_contract: Link distinct incidents to one investigation; do not merge away real recurrences

scenario: Suspected cause is recorded without evidence
acceptance_contract: Keep unknown/suspected/confirmed review states and supporting evidence; do not turn a guess into fact

scenario: Root cause action is created but repair closes
acceptance_contract: Track improvement action owner and later effectiveness review independently of repair closure

scenario: New SOP published while repair executes old revision
acceptance_contract: Pin executed revision; factory owner chooses addendum/restart/continue and records why

scenario: Draft SOP selected for production work
acceptance_contract: Only published/approved revision is selectable under the chosen document policy

scenario: Inspection route stop cannot be accessed
acceptance_contract: Record skipped stop and reason; route completion cannot invent a Pass
evidence: IBM route concept / proposed stop contract

scenario: Route reordered after yesterday’s walk
acceptance_contract: Preserve yesterday’s stop identities, order and observations; apply edits to future executions

scenario: Two immutable IDs have the same shortened work-order label
acceptance_contract: Enforce unique human reference or show unique full identifier; never mutate by an ambiguous label

scenario: Worker A is reassigned to worker B
acceptance_contract: Audit stores old/new assignee IDs, actor, command and from/to versions

scenario: Several catalog fields change in one edit
acceptance_contract: Retain meaningful before/after field diff and policy/version context, not only action=updated

scenario: Receipt takes stock above validated quantity cap
acceptance_contract: Apply the same balance invariant before receipt/adjustment; later edits must remain usable

scenario: Malformed encoded UTF-8 request arrives
acceptance_contract: Return client4xx, not server500; classify safely without logging private body

scenario: Multi-byte request exceeds byte budget but not character count
acceptance_contract: Measure decoded transport bytes under explicit budget; validate allowed command fields

scenario: Named error codes collapse into generic changed-record response
acceptance_contract: Differentiate stale version, duplicate identity and invalid reference without exposing private records

scenario: Historical action is rendered without actor role or command identity
acceptance_contract: Preserve action-time authority/source and command correlation while rechecking current authority for new actions

scenario: Reassignment resets short acknowledgment timer repeatedly
acceptance_contract: Keep overall service target separate from per-assignment acknowledgment deadlines and retain breach history

scenario: Copying a previous repair carries stale serial/parts/SOP values
acceptance_contract: Preview copied fields and require fresh asset/fitment/revision confirmation; do not copy approval/evidence as new proof
